# New-state skill map

The process flow of the [four New-State files](new-state-flow.md) with the skills that serve each step. **Named** means the New-State files name the skill on that step; **proposed** means this registry places it there and the files do not name it. The interactive version, with downloads per lane, is the process map of the documentation site (`python scripts/build_site.py`).

## Intake

*Triage + fit-check.* Known use case: Lane 1. New use case, machine connected: Lane 2. New system / connector: Lane 3.
